name: Natural Death Assistance for the Construction Workers
benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided to the nominees/dependents of the members in case of natural death of the worker.
_eligibility_text: > **For Registration** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year. > **For Application** - The nominees/dependents who has lost any registered member/worker of the due to natural death.
